text: Filecia asked for your help to make sweets to\ncheer Lefina up. Collect the ingredients she needs!
You found Broker Goblin, the minion of the merchant\nwho tricked Lefina before! It seems to be plotting\nsomething again. Let's teach it a lesson!
With transformation magic, Filecia beat Adonius who tried to\ntrick Lefina again, but she goes out of control.\nDo something to stop her!
[[N]]Collect the ingredients and report to Pelulu in Sable Plains
